purpose: Replay specification only; no executable runner or public API.
inheritance: Resolve globals/profile, then scenario overrides and named inputs. Hash the fully expanded configuration. Only scenario-local matrices expand; no cross-scenario Cartesian product.

executionPolicy.network: Local origin/data:/blob: only; abort/report external requests. Replay providers locally by content hash.
executionPolicy.pipeline: Production Viewer/camera/frame.time, native terrain, ocean shaders, reverse depth, surface identity, atmosphere and displayed pixels; no mocked output.
executionPolicy.loading: Disable expensive sky/solar work only while loading terrain; restore declared settings and complete a production frame before assertions/warmup.
executionPolicy.evidenceReuse: Record original tested revision/input/environment hashes; historical or hosted evidence is not a fresh M6 rendering run.
executionPolicy.physicalGpuUnavailable: Record BLOCKED with runtime NOT_RUN; no software substitution.

coordinateContract.longitudeUnit: degrees east; store continuous unwrapped longitude for paths and normalize only at the consumer boundary
coordinateContract.orientationUnit: degrees: heading clockwise from local north; pitch from local horizontal; roll about view axis
coordinateContract.fovUnit: degrees passed to camera.frustum.fov, as in the reference demo
coordinateContract.referenceSeaHeightMeaning: Synthetic/display ellipsoid height, not observed mean sea level.
coordinateContract.phaseRule: RTC relocation preserves base phase at equal geodetic point/time/seed. Region-anchor change may use the contract's bounded transition.

O1_LOCAL_RELIEF_L8.capMechanism: Existing override: geometric error = 0 for level >= 8.
O1_LOCAL_RELIEF_L8.hardLimitMeaning: Assertion, not tileCacheSize resident guarantee; exceedance blocks the small fixture.
O1_LOCAL_RELIEF_L8.heightDefinition: Tile samples use the declared WGS84 ENU anchor. Default=0m. Island: 400*max(0,1-hypot(east-10000,north)/4000)m. Negative-land rectangle=-80m. Lake/unknown=0m. Outside extent=unknown.
O1_LOCAL_RELIEF_L8.coverageImplementationRule: Synthetic labels enter the production consumer; global dataset correctness is tested separately.

imagery.source: globe.baseColor and production diagnostic radiance; no live provider

O1_LOCAL_RELIEF_L8.bathymetry: None. Retain the initial 0m ocean lid to expose the O1 cap defect.

O3_GLOBAL_ELLIPSOID_L8.imageryFunctionalFallback: Local Natural Earth II with asset hashes; cannot satisfy production satellite-colour acceptance.
O3_GLOBAL_ELLIPSOID_L8.imageryVisualAcceptance: License-checked local snapshot of candidate production imagery, all selected tiles content-hashed.
O3_GLOBAL_ELLIPSOID_L8.coverage: Frozen manifest and local derived masks, including seed-selected world-ocean outer component; closed components are inland-water.
O3_GLOBAL_ELLIPSOID_L8.limit: Bounded lighting/depth/colour and ocean continuity only; actual coast/terrain LOD and bathymetry require their own gates.

diagnostic.kind: analytic local-Up displacement in the production ocean mesh/shader
diagnostic.formula: height = 2 * sin(2*pi*(east/1000 - sceneSecondsFromDiagnosticEpoch/8)); no FFT, foam or wall-clock accumulation

sharedO2Configuration.apiStatus: scene.ocean.seaState mapping follows the O0 contract: windSpeed m/s, windDirection East toward North radians, fetch metres, seed uint32. Other spectrum/foam fields are proposed internal O2 preset inputs.
unresolvedBeforeO3Sampling: internal preset mapping and configuration SHA-256

geographicSamples.precisionCase: Source omits Alcatraz: retain DATA_LIMITATION, not a passed island test.
Present in source ocean layer; must be excluded by seed-selected world-ocean connectivity.

geographicSamplePreflight.rule: Query/archive all points against frozen vector and derived-mask footprints before capture. Intended classes are not query results. Missing/coarse/unknown data stays a recorded limitation/blocker; do not silently relabel.

extraOceanSamples.algorithm: uint32 state=1337; each draw state=(1664525*state+1013904223) mod 2^32, u=state/2^32. Pairs give lon=360*u1-180, lat=asin(2*u2-1) degrees. Accept processed world-ocean class only; archive accepted indices/coordinates/list hash.
extraOceanSamples.insufficientOceanSamples: BLOCKED; retain candidate list and source coverage evidence

expected: At epoch, east=250m crest +2m and east=750m trough -2m both reach production depth/colour.
Only invalid ocean lid is suppressed; the native land probe at east=12000m remains and occludes water. No double surface, z-fighting or backside leak.
Only ocean receives water. Island/lake/negative land/unknown retain previous output.
Missing child uses an actual valid parent; absent parent remains unknown. The first real mask release has no parent; use an explicit synthetic parent for that test.
Check declared level/mesh budget; preserve native land even when coarse masks omit a small island.
Atmosphere off: terrain Lambert on/off preserves known ocean radiance while native terrain retains lighting response.
One existing ACES/sRGB display transform; diagnostic output within 3 byte-code values.
Atmosphere on: correct depth-based transmittance/scattering; sky remains background surface type.

expected: Same camera enters/exits classified ocean; no ellipsoid-interior all-black frame or backside view. Native land restrictions and return-frame depth remain valid.
Record boundary at abs(signedDistance)<=0.05m. Only medium/depth access; full water optics and waterline quality belong to O7.
